description: This figure group contains a SINGLE image and it is not a scientific panel: it is the publisher "Check for updates" CrossMark badge, reproduced as a low-resolution raster graphic. The badge consists of a circular emblem whose ring is drawn as coloured segments — light blue on the upper-left and upper-right arcs, yellow/gold on the lower-left and lower-right arcs — enclosing a red, downward-pointing ribbon (bookmark) shape on a white centre. Directly below the ring the words "Check for updates" are printed in two lines of dark sans-serif type. The background is a light grey gradient field with a thin dark rule along the top and left edges, indicating a cropped page-margin element rather than a composed figure panel. There are no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no data points, no sample labels and no annotations of any kind. No caption was supplied with this image. Because the graphic contains no microstructural, compositional or property information, it cannot support any materials-science claim; downstream extraction should treat it as figure furniture (a journal/publisher watermark), not as data. Any figure number attached to it is therefore spurious.
